recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in the core FHIR checkout for FHIR-39210 unless the extension definition is intentionally brought back into core; future wording maintenance for individual-recordedSexOrGender should happen in the FHIR Extension Pack source.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core correction from Patient Administration asking that the Recorded Sex or Gender definition use "recorded sex or gender" instead of "recorded sex and gender".
initial_application: The current core checkout no longer contains the individual-recordedSexOrGender extension definition. Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed source/patient/structuredefinition-extension-individual-recordedSexOrGender.xml from R5 source, and Extension Pack commit cbd56fb05784369b71bda8afee6890042b3b8973 explicitly applied FHIR-39210 by changing the RSG type comment from "recorded sex and gender" to "recorded sex or gender".
additional_context: Patient is still active and approved in source/fhir.ini, and the current build-scoped Patient narrative already says "Recorded Sex or Gender (RSG)" and "recorded sex or gender information". Current core source and Extension Pack input have no remaining matches for the old phrase. PA minutes from 2023-02-22 also list FHIR-39210 as Persuasive in the Gender Harmony block vote approved 7-0-3.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch documenting that the authoritative extension source is in the Extension Pack and already contains the requested wording.
